summary: NEW standalone SystemVerilog policy module dma_research_policy.sv implementing the contract's 'Method control (bank E00..E5F)' block, plus one directed + reference-account Verilator C++ test and one Python build/run driver. No existing file is modified. cfg_* register access is 64-bit through index_i[12:0] (bank offset in [7:0], bits [12:8] must be zero). ARM comes from register command 1 only; there is no external arm port. Modes 0..7, 64-bit signed balance with 66-bit intermediate and no debt forgiveness, positive-side-only credit_cap clamp, cycle window started at ARM with first/last-cycle-inclusive full-activity detection, mode6 gap countdown loaded by A done (first A done excluded) with decision on the updated countdown, mode7 stale charge of the previous window's A-owner cycles at the next window end with a zero first window, sticky errors with reset/legal-CLEAR recovery only, sticky E_CNTOVF on CounterWidth overflow, and PTW attribution by (ctl_did==DID_A && ptw_r_fire_i) included in mode4 weighted cost and counted separately. Nothing was built or run by the authoring agent.

files.content: <Deliverable 1 above; apply the two fix-up notes (move the bal_r_clamped declaration above its always_comb; use nodone_run_q <= nodone_run_next) before building>

register_map.index_width: index_i[12:0]; index_i[12:8] must be 0, index_i[7:0] selects the register
register_map.writable_range: 0x04..0x10 only; every other write address sets sticky E_BADADDR; writes with wdata_i[63:32] != 0 set sticky E_BADADDR

config.0x02: ERROR sticky: b0 BADADDR, b1 BADCMD, b2 UNSUP, b3 CFGLOCK, b4 CNTOVF(fatal), b5 BALOVF(fatal), b6 CLEARILL, b7 FRZILL, b8 ARMSTATE, b9 OBS(fatal), b10 BADCFG
config.0x03: STATUS b0 armed, b1 frozen, b2 abort, read only
config.0x04: COMMAND w: 1 ARM, 2 ABORT, 3 FREEZE, 4 CLEAR; reads 0
config.0x0D: CREDIT_CAP default 65536 (positive-side clamp of the balance)

statistics_32bit_slots_in_64bit_register.0x37: mode6 gap loads (A done after the first copy)
statistics_32bit_slots_in_64bit_register.0x3E: longest V-active run without V done

tests: t_reset_defaults: magic, version, all default config values, zeroed statistics
t_bad_writes_and_sticky: unimplemented address, wdata_i[63:32]!=0, unknown command code, illegal CLEAR -> all sticky; legal CLEAR clears them
t_arm_predicates: ARM refused when quiet_i=0 / supported_i=0, status stays 0
t_config_lock: every config write while armed sets E_CFGLOCK and leaves the value unchanged; CLEAR unlocks
t_first_allow_and_mode0: first ADMIT after ARM is allowed; mode 0 always allows and never charges
t_mode1_charge_and_debt: 4096 per A issue, debt makes allow drop, window refill does not forgive debt (negative final balance)

t_window_feedback: fully-active window with 0 V done updates b upward and hits histogram bucket 0; 8 V done hits bucket 8 and steps b down; a window missing one V-active cycle is counted as partial and does not update b; refill uses the pre-window b
t_mode6_gap: first A done inserts no gap, later A done loads the current gap, allow is derived from the updated countdown, exactly one gap load recorded
t_mode7_stale: first window charges zero, second window charges the previous window's 8 A-owner cycles
t_error_abort_and_recovery: response_error_i blocks allow and raises abort in the same cycle, is sticky, and CLEAR while armed is illegal and cannot clear
t_abort_keeps_charging: ABORT forces allow low and abort high while in-flight charging continues to FREEZE
t_narrow_overflow (CounterWidth=8): 300 armed cycles wrap the statistic to 300&0xFF, set sticky E_CNTOVF, block allow even in mode 0, raise abort, and remain until a legal CLEAR
t_enabled0: magic/version readable, ARM refused with E_UNSUP, never armed, all three outputs inactive

run_reference (10 runs): per-cycle comparison of policy_enable_o/policy_allow_o/policy_abort_o against an independent cycle-accurate reference model for modes 0..7 at CounterWidth=64 plus two CounterWidth=8 runs, then final comparison of ERROR, final balance, final/min/max b, total charge, total replenish, complete windows, V done events, b-up/b-down counts, blocked cycles, longest no-done run and all 32 histogram buckets
assumptions: Port naming: clk_i/rst_ni (active-low reset) and wdata_i/rdata_o are used; the task text wrote 'clk/rst' and 'wdata64/rdata64' as shorthand.
index_i[12:0] is interpreted as a bank offset: index_i[12:8] must be zero, index_i[7:0] is the register selector. Writes outside 0x04..0x10 are rejected and sticky.
The contract's 'E06 E' is implemented as WINDOW_CYCLES (default 16384), matching the 'window配置有界，默认16384周期' sentence and the task's default list.

Feedback direction is implemented exactly as written: observed ABOVE target -> b increases, observed BELOW target -> b decreases (self-consistent reading of 'target低于观测则提高b，低于目标则降低b'). Mode 6 reverses it (V slow -> gap up). Deadband is the no-change band on both sides.
'observed' for the feedback is v_done_count * 4096 bytes compared against target_bytes; the shortfall statistics use the raw target without deadband.

The module needs to know which DID is A; added parameter DID_A with default 24'h000010. ctl_state_i encoding 0 idle / 1 REQ_TRANS / 2 AWAIT_RESP / 3 COMPLETE is parameterised (ST_REQ_TRANS, ST_AWAIT_RESP) because the contract does not fix the numbers.
The cycle window starts on the cycle after the ARM write registers; win_allact_q is seeded to 1 at ARM so the first cycle is included, and the last cycle's v_active_i is included through act_all_now.
Mode 0 performs no charge and no refill (refill_en excludes mode 0 and mode 6); mode 6 performs no per-cycle charge and no byte refill.
Mode 7 rotates prev_main/win_main at every window boundary (complete or partial); the charge at a window end is the previous window's A-owner cycle count, so the first window is zero by construction.

ABORT/FREEZE/ARM/CLEAR cannot coincide with an active window, because they all require armed_q=0 or automatically imply quiet; FREEZE is only granted when quiet_i is high, which the contract equates with the drain having completed.

A legal CLEAR resets the sticky error register, the three status flags, the balance, b, the window bookkeeping and all statistics and histogram buckets, and leaves the configuration registers untouched.
ARM does not clear statistics; only reset and a legal CLEAR do.
policy_abort_o is driven only while policy_enable_o is high, so that an unimplemented/disabled feature does not stall a legacy pipeline.
The randomized reference model is an independent re-derivation of the contract semantics written in C++; it mirrors the contract wording rather than the RTL structure.
risks: The RTL text needs the two documented fix-ups before it will elaborate (declaration order of bal_r_clamped, and nodone_run_q <= nodone_run_next).

The literal feedback direction (observed above target -> b up) is a positive-feedback controller; if the intended reading was the classic negative-feedback one, a one-line swap of fb_inc/fb_dec in section 7 and in the reference is required. Flagged for Codex review.

Verilator 4.038 support for `parameter bit` with -GEnabled=0 and for the `64'(x)` style casts was avoided on purpose (zext64/cadd functions are used instead), but the build must still be confirmed by the driver.
DID_A default 0x10 is an assumption; the contract only fixes DID10 as the V owner for the E2 timing block.
ctl_state_i numeric encoding is assumed and parameterised; a mismatched integration would silently mis-charge mode 5.
CounterWidth=8 also wraps the histogram and armed-cycle counters, so the narrow variant can only be used for the overflow test and very short runs; the driver's small variant respects that.
The mode-7 'previous complete billing window' qualifier is approximated by rotating at every window boundary; partial windows therefore also rotate. Documented, not silently changed.
No simulation, lint run, synthesis run or board test was performed by the authoring agent; every claim about behaviour is an expectation to be verified by running tests/test_research_policy.py.
